text: National Grid ESO website statement: gist written for this record (text not reproduced): third statement: the ESO does not itself generate electricity, and the root cause did not lie with the ESO's system; it describes a rare event in which two big generating units, a gas plant and an offshore wind farm, were lost almost at the same moment (time given as 16.54); other generators raised output, but not enough, so a backup protection scheme disconnected selected demand; the DNOs were given the all clear within 15 minutes; reports that DNOs had reconnected all demand by 17.40. [reported]
